creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-13 on 0.15.0. Pane p2be76c5k6 is named `muster-integrator`, and the agent in it is also a participant named `muster-integrator` in several groups (it was addressed that way by a post from another pane). A worker running `muster msg post --to muster-integrator "..."` was refused as ambiguous: "could be p2be76c5k6 or muster-integrator". Both candidates are the same agent, in the same pane. Posting with `--to p2be76c5k6` worked.

The parallel-work skill tells every worker to post `--to <integrator pane name>`, so each worker in a round hits this. Two candidates that resolve to the same pane (the participant holds that pane) are one recipient and should not be ambiguous. Card a_2dog2o3cN (across machines, `whom` prefers a pane name over a participant of the same name) is in the same lookup.
title: msg post --to <pane name> is refused as ambiguous when the pane and a participant of that name are one agent
